lede: Professional engine matching by VIN, engine code, model year, drivetrain, and ancillaries. We verify exactly which engine fits your Jaguar before any work begins — avoiding costly mis-matches.

sections.heading: What Engine Compatibility and Application Matching Involves

blocks.html: Professional engine matching goes far beyond comparing model badges. We use a multi-point verification process to ensure that any replacement or rebuilt engine is a perfect fit for your specific Jaguar — not just the same displacement, but the exact variant with the correct ancillaries, sensors, and ECU compatibility.

items: **VIN Decoding** — we use the VIN to confirm the factory-specified engine, model year, and build details
**Engine Code Verification** — comparing the stamped engine code to confirm the exact engine family and variant
**Model Year and Production Date** — identifying design updates that affect interchangeability
**Drivetrain and Transmission Matching** — ensuring correct sump, mounts, and flex plate for RWD or AWD
**Ancillary Component Audit** — checking that engine harnesses, sensors, throttle bodies, and ECUs match
**Emissions Specification** — verifying compliance with the vehicle's original emissions hardware

blocks.html: We cross-reference OEM part numbers and work with specialist suppliers to confirm compatibility before any work is undertaken — saving time, money, and unnecessary hassle.

paras: **Compatibility checks are included as part of every rebuild or replacement quotation.**

sections.heading: How Compatibility Matching Works for Your Vehicle

steps.body: You provide your VIN or registration — we decode the factory specification.
We identify the exact engine family, variant, and production details.
We cross-reference all components — ancillaries, sensors, ECU — to ensure a perfect match.
We provide a clear compatibility report and quote for any required work.

items.q: Why can't I just fit any engine with the same displacement?
items.a: Engines from the same model year and displacement can have critical differences in mounts, sumps, sensors, and ECU strategy. For example, AJ26 and AJ27 4.0-litre V8s are not directly interchangeable — cylinder heads, cams, sensors, coils, throttle body, and ECU differ. Correct matching is essential for a working installation.

items.q: How do you check compatibility using the VIN?
items.a: The VIN contains the vehicle's engine code, model year, and production details. We decode the 8th digit and other characters to confirm the factory-specified engine and build specification.

items.q: What is the difference between AJ26 and AJ27 engines?
items.a: AJ26 and AJ27 are both 4.0-litre V8s but differ in cylinder heads, cams, sensors, coils, throttle body, and ECU. They are not directly interchangeable. We verify which one your vehicle requires.

items.q: Do you match engines for AWD and RWD differences?
items.a: Yes. Sump design, mounts, and transmission compatibility differ between RWD and AWD. We check these as part of our matching process.

items.q: Can you check compatibility for an engine I've already sourced?
items.a: Yes. We can inspect the engine code, ancillaries, and components to verify if it will fit your vehicle, and advise on any required modifications or parts swaps.
